missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Коробка' stays in the nominative case as the subject standing on the table. 'Большая' is the agreeing feminine adjective, and 'на столе' gives the location.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Коробку' is the accusative direct object of 'открыл'. 'Тяжёлую' is the agreeing feminine accusative adjective describing the box being opened.
Strategic focus: Prepositional location. 'В коробке' uses the prepositional form 'коробке' after 'в' to show where the books lie. A natural way to describe contents of a container.
Strategic focus: Genitive of source. 'Из коробки' uses the genitive form 'коробки' after 'из' to express taking things out of the box. The preposition 'из' governs the genitive.
Strategic focus: Accusative of direction. 'В коробку' uses the accusative form after 'в' to show motion into the box. 'Подарок' is the accusative object being placed inside.
Strategic focus: Dative with preposition. 'К коробке' uses the dative form 'коробке' after 'к' to mark the surface the note is stuck to. 'Этой' agrees in the feminine dative.
Strategic focus: Instrumental of means. 'Коробкой' is the instrumental case, the thing used to cover the table. The instrumental answers 'with what' the action is performed.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Коробки' is the nominative plural subject standing in the corner. 'Пустые' is the agreeing plural adjective. Good practice for the plural form.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural after quantity. 'Коробок' is the genitive plural with a fleeting vowel, required after 'сколько'. A common pattern for counting and quantities.
Strategic focus: Nominative description. 'Коробка' is nominative as the subject. 'Маленькая' is the agreeing feminine predicate adjective, intensified by 'слишком'. A clean descriptive model.
